full_judgment: On the other hand, Ms. Nowazish Ara Begum, the learned Assistant Attorney General appearing for the opposite parties submits that admittedly the suit land is recorded in the khas khatian of the Government. The Government is in possession over the same and settled it in favour of opposite party No.6 and another. In that view of the matter, the application for injunction was already infractuous. The lower appellate Court in dismissing the appeal did not commit any error of law calling for interference from this Court.
